title: Smoothness Regions for Locally Private Observational ATE Estimation with and without Interaction
banked_reason: The proposal's promised necessary-and-sufficient computable characterization of all four regions, including every boundary face, is still explicitly open; the delivered strict-interaction wedge and one-sided inclusions are a weaker object.
gap_reasons: The proposal's promised necessary-and-sufficient computable characterization of all four regions, including every boundary face, is still explicitly open; the delivered strict-interaction wedge and one-sided inclusions are a weaker object.

Noninteractive attainability remains unestablished for the full class, while sequential necessity alpha+beta>=1 and sufficiency beta>=1/2 with 2beta(alpha+beta)>=beta+1 leave a substantial unresolved gap.
The endpoint N^(-2/3) certificates concern expressly constructed estimator families and cannot establish all-protocol nonmembership or unavoidable logarithmic deterioration.
proof_attempt_summary: Seven distinct local mechanisms were audited, ending with a response-calibrated dyadic family whose fixed-envelope worst-law endpoint risk is N^-2/3 rather than root-effective. The mathematical panel passed criterion equality, partial necessary and sufficient regions, and an asymmetric strict-interaction wedge, but the promised complete analytic NI/SI frontiers and boundary membership remain open. No Lean formalization was launched; family-specific failures do not establish all-protocol endpoint nonmembership.
tldr: The full-record private observational ATE has equal risk and finite-honest-length precision regions for each protocol type, with established inclusions and strict interaction. A calibrated dyadic endpoint attempt now closes its comparison-mean bias at \(C/N\), but independent histogram projections survive. Every bounded additive member of the audited family has matched \(N^{-2/3}\) worst-law MSE. The all-protocol endpoint and complete analytic regions remain unresolved.
gap: Published local functional estimation distinguishes density-quadratic interaction thresholds, while causal higher-order correction theory uses raw records and a propensity-dependent projection measure. Neither theorem scope supplies asymmetric primitive-smoothness regions for a confounded average effect under full-record pure local privacy.
fill: An analytic four-region characterization is paired with computable attaining original-input protocols, direct honest-length certificates and all-protocol impossibility outside each region. The proposal retains the entire prescribed model and leaves every exact boundary answer to derivation.
